deadline.value: Fall applications, with the fee and all documents, must reach the department by January 15.
deadline.quote: If you are applying for September (i.e. Fall) admission, then you should make sure that we have received all of your application materials (including transcripts, letters of appraisal, and the application fee) by January 15

gre_general.value: The department says it does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: No, we do not require GRE scores

gre_subject.value: The department says it does not require GRE scores, so no subject test is needed.
gre_subject.quote: No, we do not require GRE scores

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact a faculty supervisor when applying.
supervisor.quote: Graduate applicants interested in research-based programs are strongly encouraged to connect with a faculty supervisor at the time of application

funding.value: Memorial describes competitive funding packages for eligible full-time PhD students; the PhD is listed at $22,300 a year.
funding.quote: Memorial University offers competitive funding packages to academically eligible full-time graduate students, both Canadian and international, in all eligible research programs

entry_route.value: Students normally finish a master's before a PhD here.
entry_route.quote: It is normal for students to first obtain a Master's degree before being admitted into one of our PhD programs

notes: Covers PhD in Mathematics and Statistics. The deadlines table also lists Mathematics (PhD) for Winter (August 15). The department page gives older TOEFL section minimums (19 reading, listening and speaking; 24 writing) as one acceptable proof, which conflicts with the university 80 overall; the university rule was kept.
